constraints: DBB; scope and budget changes require macro approval

owner_requirements.project_scope: 澳门新葡京酒店文旅与酒店娱乐项目，建筑面积约13.5万平方米，采用DBB交付模式，总预算MOP 150,000,000，工期24个月。本次业主方模拟包简报仅针对已授权供应包「CASE-0206/supply-1 主体结构与土建工程包材料采购」：该包为施工包「主体结构与土建工程包」供应其施工所需的结构材料与土建辅材，范围包括供货、运输到场、质量证明文件提交及质保期内更换；不含任何施工、安装、临时工程或措施费，不承担施工界面责任。材料费用已包含在施工包合同价MOP 64,500,000内，由施工包承包商作为买方支付。本包预算为MOP 18,900,000，业主方作为模拟采购组织方，通过招标文件与合同条款设定质量、可追溯、交付与文档要求，以间接方式保持对主体结构材料质量与供货节奏的可控性。
functional_requirements: 供应包须覆盖13.5万平方米酒店主体结构、桩基与地下室、混凝土与钢结构、砌体、屋面及外立面结构找平所需的结构主材与土建辅材，并明确哪些构配件由本包供应、哪些由施工包自购。
供应包须按施工进度计划分批供货到场，提供材料到场节点清单，支撑现场连续施工，避免停工等料。
供应包须提交完整材料质量证明文件，包括材质证明、检验报告、合格证及来源可追溯声明，作为到场验收与结构验收的可核查依据。
供应包须提供质保期内更换承诺，明确更换响应时限与责任界面。
供应包须提供材料来源可追溯声明与环保合规声明，作为投标必备承诺内容。
供应包须提供与施工包安装界面的技术资料与接口信息，包括预埋件、预留孔洞相关构配件的尺寸、规格与到场包装要求。
供应包须提供备品备件计划与售后支持安排，支撑运营期维护。
technical_requirements: BIM协调：供应包须提供材料与构配件的BIM信息或规格数据，配合施工包完成结构预埋件与预留孔洞的BIM协调。
MEP协调：供应包须就与机电安装相关的结构预埋件、套管及预留孔洞材料提供接口信息，配合施工包完成MEP协调。
结构协调：供应包须确保结构主材与土建辅材的规格、等级、尺寸与施工包结构设计一致，并提供结构找平材料的兼容性说明。
运输接口布局：供应包须提供运输到场方案，明确卸货点、批次划分与到场时间窗口，配合施工包现场平面布置。
公共通道布局：材料运输与到场堆放不得影响项目公共通道与酒店运营区域，供应包须在供货方案中说明运输路线与临时堆放安排。
耐久性目标：结构主材与土建辅材须满足设计使用年限与酒店运营环境耐久性要求，供应包须提供材料耐久性参数。
可维护性目标：供应包须提供材料维护说明与备件建议，支撑运营期可维护性。
业主验收路径：材料到场验收须经施工包初验、监理见证取样与业主抽查复核，质量证明文件须随批次提交，验收记录纳入竣工资料。
能耗目标：供应包须优先提供符合项目可持续发展目标的低碳或可回收材料选项，并在投标文件中说明材料能耗与环保参数。
owner_requirements.budget_policy: 本包预算为MOP 18,900,000，对应结构主材与土建辅材的供货、运输到场、质量证明文件及质保期更换费用。材料费用已包含在施工包合同价MOP 64,500,000内，由施工包承包商作为买方支付，业主不直接与供应商签约。业主方要求成本控制职能就MOP 18,900,000预算所对应的材料范围与价格基础出具书面口径，作为招标文件与评标依据。考虑到材料价格指数为1.1124，投标报价须说明价格调整机制与价格基础，业主方将按价格合理性、范围完整性与质量证明文件投入进行综合比较。预算变更须经宏观审批，本包不接受范围外增项。
owner_requirements.schedule_policy: 总工期24个月。供应包须按施工包进度计划编制材料到场节点清单，明确各批结构主材与土建辅材的计划到场时间，并预留业主审查时间与包间接口协调时间。业主方要求供应包在投标文件中提交进度视图，说明供货周期、运输时间、质量证明文件准备时间与质保更换响应时间。材料到场节点须与施工包工序排程衔接，并考虑公共通道协调时间。业主方将按里程碑现实性、供货节奏可靠性与接口时间充裕度进行定性比较。
compliance_requirements: 业主审查节奏：业主方按招标文件约定节点审查材料范围清单、到场节点清单与质量证明文件提交清单，审查意见作为判给前澄清事项。
问题升级路径：供应包履约中的范围争议、质量证明文件缺失或到场延误，须按施工包→业主方→供应商路径升级，业主方保留最终裁定权。
文档纪律：供应包须按批次提交完整质量证明文件与来源可追溯声明，文档编号与版本须可追溯，未提交完整文件的批次不予到场验收。
接口签署：供应包与施工包的供货界面、运输接口与质量证明文件交接须经双方签署确认，业主方抽查复核。
公共通道协调：材料运输与到场堆放须服从业主方公共通道协调安排，不得影响酒店运营与公共安全。
质量目标跟踪：业主方按批次跟踪材料质量证明文件提交率、到场验收合格率与质保更换响应及时率。
安全期望跟踪：供应包须遵守现场安全期望，运输与卸货作业须符合施工包安全管理要求，业主方跟踪安全事件记录。
变更控制纪律：材料范围、到场节点或质量证明文件要求的变更须经业主方书面批准，变更不得降低质量与可追溯标准。
risk_priorities: 范围不清风险：MOP 18,900,000预算对应的材料范围清单尚未落到纸面，投标人可能按各自理解报价，低价者可能压缩质量证明文件与质保期更换投入，削弱业主对结构材料质量的信心。
供货节奏风险：到场节点不清可能导致现场停工等料，直接影响工期与成本可控性。

clauses.scope_and_interfaces: Supplier COMP-0167 remains the single responsible supplier for package CASE-0206/supply-1: supply, transport to site, submission of quality certification documents and warranty-period replacement of structural main materials (rebar, section steel, precast structural components, structural embedments) and civil auxiliary materials (masonry, roof screed materials, waterproofing and waterstop auxiliaries, formwork materials). Excluded: any construction, installation, temporary works or measure costs, and any construction-interface responsibility. Interface information (material specifications, embedment positioning parameters) is provided by the supplier as an information table for the construction package's use only; it creates no installation obligation. The supplier locks the sub-item sources of structural and civil materials itself before supply and bears the associated risk; the sub-item cost breakdown is attached to the contract solely as supporting documentation for the fixed price and is not a basis for price adjustment. The supplier's disclosed bid assumptions on source locking and batch arrival nodes are accepted as stated risk allocations to the supplier, not as conditions precedent to signing.
clauses.price_and_change_control: Contract price is a fixed lump sum of MOP 18,080,000 (Macao Patacas eighteen million eighty thousand), covering all supply, transport to site, quality certification document submission and warranty-period replacement costs, excluding construction, installation, temporary works and measure costs. No material price index linkage adjustment clause applies; the bid's index-1.11-based adjustment wording and price-volatility buffer clause are not incorporated, and the fixed lump sum does not adjust during the contract term for material price fluctuation. No uncapped price adjustment is added to the authorized scope; any request for index linkage or other price adjustment remains unresolved and would require re-tendering. No out-of-scope additions are accepted; the supplier's no-out-of-scope-additions position is accepted as a binding obligation. The buyer's decision on price basis is final for this draft: fixed lump sum, no index linkage.
clauses.payment_terms: Payment is made in installments against acceptance of each delivered material batch. The buyer completes acceptance confirmation within 10 working days after each batch arrives on site; payment for an accepted batch follows that confirmation. A batch whose third-party re-inspection fails is suspended from use, and re-inspection and replacement costs for that batch are borne by the supplier. No payment is due for a batch until it passes acceptance, including quality document verification.
clauses.delivery_and_review: Supply follows a three-batch framework: batch 1 pile foundation and basement materials; batch 2 main structure materials; batch 3 masonry, roof screed and finishing auxiliary materials. Specific arrival nodes are provided by the construction package as progress requirements after contract effectiveness and are locked upon written confirmation by both parties; before confirmation the supplier schedules production under the three-batch framework, and after confirmation the locked nodes govern. Locked nodes are a supply-plan obligation and not a price-adjustment event. For each batch, the supplier submits at arrival the factory certificate, material inspection report and source-traceability statement; the third-party re-inspection report is supplemented within 5 working days after arrival; documents are released to the construction package only after independent review and signature by the quality department. Warranty runs from acceptance of the last batch. During warranty, the supplier responds within 48 hours of a replacement notice and completes replacement or supplementary supply within 7 working days for non-human-caused material defects; spare parts of approximately 1.5% are reserved by material category and delivered with the first batch or in batches per construction-package demand.
clauses.response_to_feedback: Buyer COMP-0153 feedback is adopted as binding: fixed lump sum MOP 18,080,000; no index linkage; supplier locks sources and bears that risk; batch nodes are a supply obligation; quality documents and warranty replacement (48-hour response, 7-working-day replacement, approximately 1.5% spares) remain contract obligations. Bidder COMP-0167 feedback is partly adopted and partly rejected: the batch-node confirmation mechanism, quality-document deadlines, re-inspection cost allocation and 10-working-day buyer acceptance are adopted; the requested index-linkage formula P_adj = P_base x (I_current / 1.11 - 1) is rejected and remains unresolved, requiring re-tendering if pursued. The bidder's position that source locking and batch nodes are disclosed assumptions is accepted as a risk allocation to the supplier, not as a condition precedent. Price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments are unchanged. Each party remains free to reject this draft.

The bidder's position that source locking and batch nodes are disclosed assumptions is accepted as a risk allocation to the supplier, not as a condition precedent. Price, currency, scope boundaries, parties, work shares and resource commitments are unchanged. Each party remains free to reject this draft.
